Description: Occuring during the reproductive period of the year, for seasonal breeders. Oftentimes this is during the summer in the relevant hemisphere.
Occuring during the period between breeding and non-breeding, often while the species is migrating to or from breeding/wintering grounds.
Occuring during the non-reproductive period of the year, for seasonal breeders. Oftentimes this is during the winter in the relevant hemisphere.
Occuring during the majority or all of the year.
